The agent called get_user_details which returned the user's actual orders: #W8661412, #W2273457, and #W9284598.
Instead of inspecting the items inside the returned orders to find the digital camera, the agent assumed the user's order ID was simply too new and failed to look up the correct order.
inference: Had the agent checked the details of the actual orders belonging to the user (such as #W9284598 which contained the digital camera), the agent would have found the correct order and completed the task successfully.
